title: gate-secrets.json (FLEET_OPS_REPO)
description: #1346: the gate-scoped-secrets allowlist. Lives ONLY in the operator's private OPS repo (FLEET_OPS_REPO, see src/ops-repo.ts), at the path secrets-config.ts's GATE_SECRETS_ALLOWLIST_PATH names ('gate-secrets.json'). Never in a gated repo's own fleet.json -- a PR author can edit that file, so an allowlist living there could grant itself a secret. Top-level keys are 'owner/repo' (matched case-insensitively). Each value maps a leg name (the same string the repo's own fleet.json gate block names in its 'legs' array) to the list of secret NAMEs that leg may receive. A name here is an opaque label -- never a value, an env var name, or a Worker secret binding name; secrets-registry.ts (committed, public) is the only place a name resolves to anything real, and only a same-repo PR (never a fork) ever receives a grant at all -- see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-gate-scoped-secrets-design.md.

additionalProperties.description: Leg name -> secret names granted to that leg, for this one repo.
Secret NAMEs (must exist in secrets-registry.ts's SECRET_REGISTRY; an unknown name grants nothing).
